0|0ec986ed7bab6801faed1440e8839dcc710331ff|torvalds~linux|/home/usuario01/Titan-Files-Research/src/_00/output/C/torvalds~linux|False|"tcp: fix incorrect undo caused by DSACK of TLP retransmit
Loss recovery undo_retrans bookkeeping had a long-standing bug where a
DSACK from a spurious TLP retransmit packet could cause an erroneous
undo of a fast recovery or RTO recovery that repaired a single
really-lost packet (in a sequence range outside that of the TLP
retransmit). Basically
column2: because the loss recovery state machine didn't

column1: account for the fact that it sent a TLP retransmit
TLP retransmit could erroneously be implicitly be interpreted as
corresponding to the normal fast recovery or RTO recovery retransmit
that plugged a real hole
column2: thus resulting in an improper undo.

column1: For example
column2: consider the following buggy scenario where there is a

column1: real packet loss but the congestion control response is improperly
undone because of this bug:
+ send packets P1
+ P1 is really lost
+ send TLP retransmit of P4
+ receive SACK for original P2
+ enter fast recovery
+ receive DSACK for TLP P4
+ receive cumulative ACK for P1-P4 (fast retransmit plugged real hole)
The fix: when we initialize undo machinery in tcp_init_undo()
there is a TLP retransmit in flight
so that we make sure that we receive a DSACK corresponding to the TLP
retransmit
column2: as well as DSACKs for all later normal retransmits

column1: triggering a loss recovery undo. Note that we also have to move the
line that clears tp->tlp_high_seq for RTO recovery
we remember the tp->tlp_high_seq value until tcp_init_undo() and clear
it only afterward.
Also note that the bug dates back to the original 2013 TLP
implementation
However
column2: this patch will only compile and work correctly with kernels

column1: that have tp->tlp_retrans
column2: which was added only in v5.8 in 2020 in

column1: commit 76be93fc0702 (""tcp: allow at most one TLP probe per flight"").
So we associate this fix with that later commit.
Fixes: 76be93fc0702 (""tcp: allow at most one TLP probe per flight"")
